description: Build a spec-compliant x402 v2 payment challenge (402 response body) from a price, wallet and network. Returns the challenge JSON, the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value, a curl test command, and free code snippets (Cloudflare Worker, Express) to return it. Free, no auth. Pre-validated: the same shape checks x402lint.js runs on existing endpoints.

asset.description: Token contract address, default USDC on Base.

description.description: Human description of what's being sold.

pay_to.description: 0x-prefixed EVM wallet address to receive payment.

resource.description: The URL this challenge is for, default a placeholder.

name: generate_x402_challenge
